sidebar.savedInBrowserTitle: Notes are stored in this browser. If cloud sync is enabled, they are also synchronized to your configured storage.

editor.richEditorLoadFailed: The rich editor could not be loaded. Your Markdown is still safe.

status.offlineTitle: You're offline. Edits are saved on this device and sync when reconnected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fontCustomStackHint: CSS font-family, e.g. Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif
settings.customCssHint: Overrides app styles. Targets like :root and body[data-build="server"] work.
settings.imageSecretUnchanged: Leave empty to keep the current value
settings.imageCleanupWarning: When enabled, the server periodically deletes images no note references.
settings.imageCleanupWarningRisk: Images referenced only by deleted notes or unsaved drafts may be removed; in S3 mode deletion is remote and permanent.
settings.imageCleanupWarningDedicated: Use a dedicated bucket/prefix for MemoDump so other files are never affected.
settings.imageReadOnlySource: Configured via server environment / launch flags; read-only here
settings.imagePublicReadHelp: The bucket must allow public reads, otherwise images show 403.
settings.imageCorsNotNeeded: The web/Wails builds upload through the server proxy, so bucket CORS is not required there.
settings.imagePrivacyWarning: In S3 mode, uploaded images are publicly readable by anyone with the link; the content hash is not access control, and identical files produce identical links. Do not upload images that must stay private.
settings.imageLocalStorageWarning: Keys are stored only in this browser.
settings.syncIntro: Keep your notes in sync through private S3-compatible storage.
settings.syncSafety: Notes are uploaded without end-to-end encryption. Deletions sync to every connected device.
settings.syncNoE2EE: No end-to-end encryption. Notes are stored on the provider in plaintext.
settings.syncExperimental: Experimental: sync is opt-in and its behavior may change.
settings.syncConfigReadOnly: Note sync is configured by environment variables on this device.
settings.syncServerCredentialWarning: Credentials are stored on this device, not encrypted.
settings.syncSecretUnchanged: Leave blank to keep the current secret
settings.syncCredentialWarning: Credentials are stored in this browser, not encrypted.
settings.syncDeletesPropagate: Deleting a synced note deletes it from every synced device.
settings.syncCorsHint: Private note storage requires CORS to allow the signed PUT/GET/DELETE methods and the Authorization, If-Match, If-None-Match, and x-amz-* headers, and to expose the ETag and Retry-After response headers.
settings.syncResetConfirm: Connect to different storage? This clears the current connection and this device's sync state. Your notes and recovery copies are kept.
settings.syncAutoNote: A connected replica synchronizes at startup and every five minutes while MemoDump is running.
settings.syncSyncingDetail: Checking this device and cloud storage for changes.
settings.syncConnectedHelp: Sync runs automatically while MemoDump is open.
settings.syncDisconnected: Sync is off on this device. Your notes and connection details are kept.

media.imageOff: Image upload is not configured — set it up in Settings first.
